name: cdx-summary (cdxsummary)
what_it_holds: Python tool (pip: cdxsummary; 100 stars, 125 commits, AGPL-3.0) that summarizes a CDX file (local, remote, gz/bz2, or a live Wayback CDX Server query / Petabox item): capture counts, unique URLs/hosts, MIME/status distributions, year/month breakdowns, top hosts, sample memento URLs.
why_useful: Quick reconnaissance layer before a full crawl — could scope how many archived captures exist for airbnb.com press/newsroom paths, insideairbnb.com, or airdna.co/mashvisor.com by year before committing to a full waybackpack/downloader pull.
time_coverage: matches whatever CDX index is queried
themes: Wayback Machine / Internet Archive tooling and archived-page datasets (archived airbnb.com pages, archived AirDNA/Mashvisor market pages, archived Inside Airbnb site)
why_all: Quick reconnaissance layer before a full crawl — could scope how many archived captures exist for airbnb.com press/newsroom paths, insideairbnb.com, or airdna.co/mashvisor.com by year before committing to a full waybackpack/downloader pull.

name: waybackurls
what_it_holds: Small Go tool (4.6k stars) that lists every URL the Wayback Machine has archived for a given domain (pipe domains in, get URLs out).
why_useful: Simpler single-purpose alternative to gau for the same URL-discovery use case against AirDNA/Mashvisor/Inside Airbnb domains.
license: unspecified in fetched content (commonly MIT upstream)
time_coverage: full Wayback CDX depth for the domain
themes: Wayback Machine / Internet Archive tooling and archived-page datasets (archived airbnb.com pages, archived AirDNA/Mashvisor market pages, archived Inside Airbnb site)
why_all: Simpler single-purpose alternative to gau for the same URL-discovery use case against AirDNA/Mashvisor/Inside Airbnb domains.

name: ArchiveSpark
what_it_holds: Apache Spark framework (Internet Archive-authored, MIT, 162 stars, 154 commits) for large-scale filtering/extraction/derivation over web-archive collections (WARC/CDX), including direct access to Wayback Machine holdings; outputs to JSON while preserving data lineage.
why_useful: If a large-scale pull of archived Airbnb/AirDNA/Inside-Airbnb pages across many years and thousands of URLs is ever attempted, this is the scale-appropriate processing layer (vs. one-off scripts) — same use case as our existing Common Crawl WARC renders (3,000 already pulled) but for Wayback's index.
last_activity: unspecified, versioned to 3.0 with recent namespace updates
time_coverage: matches whatever archive collection is targeted
themes: Wayback Machine / Internet Archive tooling and archived-page datasets (archived airbnb.com pages, archived AirDNA/Mashvisor market pages, archived Inside Airbnb site)
why_all: If a large-scale pull of archived Airbnb/AirDNA/Inside-Airbnb pages across many years and thousands of URLs is ever attempted, this is the scale-appropriate processing layer (vs. one-off scripts) — same use case as our existing Common Crawl WARC renders (3,000 already pulled) but for Wayback's index.

name: ipwb (InterPlanetary Wayback)
what_it_holds: MIT-licensed project (1,622 commits) that converts WARC files to IPFS-distributed archives and replays them; includes only small sample WARC files for testing, no real datasets.
why_useful: Marginal for our purposes — a decentralized-storage/replay layer, not an acquisition method for new data. Flagged for completeness under 'Wayback tooling' but not directly actionable.
themes: Wayback Machine / Internet Archive tooling and archived-page datasets (archived airbnb.com pages, archived AirDNA/Mashvisor market pages, archived Inside Airbnb site)
why_all: Marginal for our purposes — a decentralized-storage/replay layer, not an acquisition method for new data. Flagged for completeness under 'Wayback tooling' but not directly actionable.

name: archivenow
what_it_holds: MIT-licensed tool (434 stars, 186 commits) to push a live URL into multiple public archives at once (Internet Archive, Archive.today, Perma.cc, Megalodon.jp) via CLI, Python library, web service, or Docker; can also produce local WARC files.
why_useful: Forward-looking companion to the retrieval tools above: could be used going forward to proactively archive AirDNA/Mashvisor market pages or Airbnb newsroom/investor pages on a schedule so future point-in-time snapshots exist (addresses the point-in-time rule in our own CLAUDE.md, not retroactive data).
last_activity: last noted feature change January 2021 (removed WebCite/Archive.st)
time_coverage: prospective only (captures made from now on)
themes: Wayback Machine / Internet Archive tooling and archived-page datasets (archived airbnb.com pages, archived AirDNA/Mashvisor market pages, archived Inside Airbnb site)
